body:
# 🌑 Moon-Titan — Modded PvP Events, Every Day

Moon-Titan is an event network built around competitive Battle Royale PvP and custom mods.


---

## ⚔️ The Titan Combat System

At the heart of Moon-Titan is **Titan Reborn** — a custom mod that completely overhauls combat:

- **Three new ores:** Citrin, Ember, and Titan — each with unique armor, swords, and abilities
- **No attack cooldown** — fluid, fast-paced PvP the way it should be
- **Greatswords** — a new weapon class with its own playstyle
- **New items:** Titan Bows, Multi-Bows, Citrin Star, Potion of Immunity, Diamond Apple, Parachute, Backpacks, and more

---

## 🎮 Game Modes

### ⚡ OneDayTitan
A compressed survival-PvP experience packed into roughly one hour. You start with a starter kit (food, tools, a parachute) and have to fight your way to the top.

**How it plays out:**
1. 🎒 **Start** — Everyone gets a starter kit
2. 🛡️ **0–15 min** — Protection phase: gather resources, no targeting allowed
3. ⚔️ **15 min** — PvP goes live, the Nether opens
4. 🌍 **Ongoing** — The border slowly shrinks, forcing players together
5. 🔥 **60 min** — Nether closes, underground becomes deadly — last one standing wins

---
![PvP Action](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/03a7e8560dc36b97bef81add848d6b37d7059cc6.png)
### 🎲 Kitfight
Pure PvP with randomly assigned kits — no farming, no prep, just skill. Every round is different.

- Each player gets a **random kit** from one of three tiers: **Basic**, **Advanced Stuff**, or **OP Stuff**
- Short orientation phase, then PvP is immediately live
- **Kills upgrade your gear** — the more you fight, the stronger you get
- Only Plains & Forest biomes — no distractions, just combat
- Anvil available for repairs and enchanting
